calc_items.title: F-100 rehabilitation energy (Day 14 C4 repair)
calc_items.question: A 9-kg child has a hypothetical rehabilitation energy target of 150 kcal/kg/day. If F-100 is 1 kcal/mL, calculate the energy per day and the theoretical volume per day. This is arithmetic, not a feeding order.

calc_items.title: D10 bolus volume and glucose (Day 14 C6 repair)
calc_items.question: A 7-kg child receives a hypothetical D10 bolus of 5 mL/kg under a clinician order. Find the volume (mL) and the glucose mass (g).

calc_items.title: F-100 energy goal (Day 14 C8 repair)
calc_items.question: An 11-kg child has a hypothetical 140 kcal/kg/day energy goal. Calculate the kcal/day and the F-100 energy-equivalent mL/day (1 kcal/mL).
